name: CikguLaju legacy worksheet restoration inventory
purpose: Discover and audit old worksheets without publishing or modifying their source databases

sources.role: visual production queue; no image-ready claim
legacy visuals; licensing and quality unknown
old curriculum-material mapping, not the live curriculum DB

review_rules: No legacy content is approved merely because a row or template exists
Validate subject, Year, Tema/Unit/Tajuk, SK/SP, lesson and current DSKP/RPT/textbook
Reject blank, duplicated, generic, factually wrong, age-inappropriate or broken-image tasks
Check source rights, answer spaces, Malay/English language, A4 PDF and editable Word
Do not show SK/SP in student worksheet artwork; keep curriculum mapping in metadata
Only manually approved records may be promoted by a separate reviewed change
Do not alter production database, Telegram, quota, payment or the disabled BBM/Worksheet gate
